text:
These rainy nights I hear them on the panes,

these windy nights and I cannot move.


At the door of fear the guard keeps watch,

child prisoner, lest he be unchained.


Other nights of deep rain on the panes,

other nights of wind and I question again.


Because everything was useless I have changed masters,

at the door of sleep, lady of clarity.

translation.title: These Nights of Rain I Hear Them on the Panes...
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the guarded fear and the final turn toward sleep as a new master.
